newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia seizes biggest drug haul.
newsitem.headline: Australia seizes biggest drug haul.

text.p: Australian customs said on Wednesday it had seized 10 tonnes of cannabis resin, worth about A$77 million (US$61 million), in the nation's biggest drug haul.
The drugs were found aboard a fishing vessel at Port Stephens in New South Wales state on Sunday night, the Australian Customs Service said in a statement.
"The seizure...has now been confirmed as Australia's largest ever single drugs haul," it said.
Australian Federal Police arrested three Australian men, who were charged with importing cannabis resin.

It is the third large drugs haul in Australia in recent months. Five tonnes of compressed cannabis was seized on a ship in Sydney in November and eight tonnes of cannabis resin was found aboard a vessel in Queensland state in December.
